ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: there is a circle in the figure, point D is marked inside the circle and serves as the position of the center of the circle; from external point X, line segment XE is drawn, and point E is on the circle; there is a right-angle mark at point E in the figure, indicating DE ⟂ EX. Therefore triangle DEX is a right triangle, with the right angle at E, and DX is the hypotenuse. Then reason: it is known that EX = 24, DE = 7. By the Pythagorean theorem, DX² = EX² + DE² = 24² + 7² = 576 + 49 = 625, so DX = 25.
